diagnosis: Customer on Legacy Auth is asking how to rotate the account-wide API token. KB-0002 covers the exact flow: Security tab > Reset token, with the old token remaining valid for 24 hours. Straightforward how-to, no escalation needed.
reply:
Thanks for reaching out — happy to walk you through resetting the API token.

Because your account is on Legacy Auth, it has an account-wide token that can be reset directly:

1. Open the **Security** tab in your account settings.
2. Choose **Reset token**.

The previous token will remain valid for 24 hours after the reset, which gives your integration vendor a window to swap in the new token without downtime. Once that window passes, the old token will no longer work.

One note: this account-wide token flow applies only to Legacy Auth accounts. If your account migrates to Unified Auth in the future, tokens would instead be replaced with scoped keys, and that migration is not reversible once legacy tokens are disabled.

If you run into any trouble during the reset, let us know and we'll help troubleshoot.
